data.description: Things still to do, earliest first. Work whose deadline has passed is included, not filtered out: it is the most important thing on the list.

title.description: Moodle's own sentence, such as "Essay 1 is due"

activity.description: The activity itself, without the sentence around it

kind.description: Moodle's event type: due, open, close and so on. Passed through, because plugins define their own.

module.description: The activity type, such as assign

cmid.description: Course module id, which links an event back to the activity. NOT the activity's own id: an assignment with id 1 has a cmid of 2. Join it against an assignment's cmid.

overdue.description: Moodle's own verdict, which accounts for extensions and cut-offs that comparing against the clock cannot see.

action_name.description: What Moodle suggests doing, such as "Add submission"

actionable.description: Whether the action can still be taken; null when the event carries no action for this account

source.description: Which of the site's answers returned this event

url.description: Null when Moodle's link carried a session key, which is never passed on
